skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understanding the methodology of regression analysis, including model components, assumptions, estimation methods (OLS, MLE), hypothesis testing, and prediction.
Performing statistical inference on regression coefficients, predictions, and error estimates.
Specifying regression models based on economic theories and data characteristics.
Conducting diagnostic tests for model adequacy, including checking for heteroskedasticity, autocorrelation, and multicollinearity.
Handling qualitative variables in regression models, including dummy variables and interaction terms.
Analyzing time series data using regression techniques, including dealing with trends, seasonality, and autocorrelation.
Proficient use of statistical software (R, Python) for data manipulation, visualization, and regression analysis.
Working effectively in teams, conducting independent research, and presenting findings.
Analyzing and interpreting regression results critically, considering economic implications and policy recommendations.
